page.overview:
What is Sarkomand?

Sarkomand is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It was originally created by H. P. Lovecraft for his novella The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath.

Sarkomand is an ancient, ruined city situated in the northern Dreamlands, in a valley by the Plateau of Leng, above an entrance to the underground Abyss sections of the Dreamlands. It is beside the sea, but the rocks are jagged; human ships do not go there, although Black Galleys sometimes do.

Out in the water is a mountainous granite island, with windowless dwellings and paths carved into the rock, inhabited by Moon-beasts and their slaves. (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath)

The city was "proud and pillared ... wondrous with high fanes and carven places", filled with pillars of black stone. It was a seaport. In modern times its stones and pillars are broken, and overgrown with weeds and grass.
